goal: Expand component-family evidence beyond the TC001 seed glyphs and promote only cross-example invariants into stable Teacher Memory.

researchBasis.note: The Palace Museum's Shengjiao technical-study framework explicitly treats basic strokes, component combinations, structural characteristics and same-character variants as study dimensions. Huairen Shengjiao remains single-glyph evidence only in this project.

日.promotionQuestion: Does 日 retain a recognizable inner-space and enclosure strategy across independent host characters while changing proportion contextually?

心.promotionQuestion: What remains recognizable when 心 is compressed below a dense upper body versus written with more lateral freedom?

立.promotionQuestion: How does 立 narrow, tilt or simplify without losing its stabilizing function?

口.promotionQuestion: Which enclosure cues are indispensable, and which edges may open or merge in running-script transmission?

矢-知.promotionQuestion: Can a stable 知 skeleton be distinguished from incidental carving or compilation effects?

耑.promotionQuestion: Which structural cues preserve 耑 identity under compression?

dense-upper-plus-heart.promotionQuestion: How does the whole character prevent a dense upper body plus 心 from becoming a single dark rectangular mass?

evidenceLadder: continuous transmitted Wang manuscript/copy with defensible single-glyph identity
early transmitted Wang copy or facsimile preserving glyph structure
Huairen collected Wang form via early rubbing
later Wang-model copy/rubbing with explicit provenance

promotionRules.supported-pattern: At least two verified examples with compatible behavior and no decisive contradiction.
promotionRules.stable-rule: Evidence spans multiple host glyphs and, where possible, more than one transmitted witness class.
promotionRules.state-dependent-rule: A behavior recurs but varies systematically with host position, density or script state.
promotionRules.conflicted: Credible evidence disagrees without a defensible state/context explanation; retain both rather than average.

antiContamination: Do not promote carving thickness to brush-pressure memory.
Do not use Shengjiao neighboring characters as Wang flow evidence.
Do not paste radicals or average outlines.
Do not treat a modern reconstructed Wang-style glyph as historical evidence.
Do not let public-display eligibility affect internal research value.

tc001Payoff.智: Resolve the internal behavior of 知/口/日 before any stylistic reconstruction.
tc001Payoff.慧: Increase evidence for 心 and dense-upper-to-heart handoff before declaring a stable Wang solution.
tc001Payoff.端: Test 立 and 耑 independently so the final character is not merely copied from one transmitted occurrence.
tc001Payoff.futureMissingGlyphs: Use component rules as constraints on whole-character reconstruction, never as detachable pieces.

nextGate.name: first-component-promotions
nextGate.requirement: Run remote text/index discovery for the expansion targets, bind verified Wang-form occurrences, and promote only the first evidence-backed supported-patterns; no glyph generation yet.
